message.arcanelocomotion.mode_load: Load mode: fills carts from the tubes
message.arcanelocomotion.mode_unload: Unload mode: empties carts into the tubes
message.arcanelocomotion.rod_no_vis: Not enough Aer and Ordo in your wand
message.arcanelocomotion.rune_unset: Not tuned: use an item on it to tune it to that item's strongest aspect
message.arcanelocomotion.station_load: Load mode: lets the cart go once it is full
message.arcanelocomotion.station_unload: Unload mode: lets the cart go once it is empty
research.arcanelocomotion.arcane_booster: A powered rail nudges a cart along. Motus is motion itself: fed into the rail, it ought to do far more than nudge.

Arcane Booster Track works as a powered rail. While it is powered and holds Motus, it spends one point of Motus on each cart that enters it and throws the cart forward three times as hard as a powered rail would, so it runs much further before it slows. Feed it Motus through a tube from below, or use a jar or phial of Motus on it; it holds 64. Without Motus it is an ordinary powered rail.
research.arcanelocomotion.arcane_masonry: A railway that carries essentia and walks with golems should look the part. The stations deserve better than cobblestone.

Six building sets for stations and track beds: Arcane and Void Steel Plating, Greatwood Sleepers, Runed Abyssal and Runed Quarried Bricks, and Thaumium-Banded Bricks. Each comes as a block, slab, stairs and wall, made at a crafting table or a stonecutter.
research.arcanelocomotion.aura_locomotiv: An electric locomotive drinks charge from a battery. The aura is a battery that fills itself, if a little slowly.

The Aura Locomotive is an electric locomotive that needs no charge: it draws vis from the aura of the chunk it is in, a little at a time, as it runs. It never runs faster than Normal speed, and on a drained aura it stops until the vis comes back. Mind the flux on busy lines.
Out past the edge of things the rails run straight and nothing slows. Laid here, they would carry that speed with them. Something else comes with it.

Eldritch Rail is laid like any rail. An Eldritch Cart on it runs more than twice as fast as a cart ever should; on other track it is an ordinary cart, and on eldritch rail other carts are too. Fire and creatures cannot harm the cart. Each eldritch rail its rider crosses has a small chance to leave a point of temporary warp. Learning this costs two warp.
research.arcanelocomotion.essentia_freig: Jars on a wagon would slosh and crack at the first set of points. A warded jar strapped into a cart, filled and emptied through tubes at the station, could carry essentia from the smeltery to the far end of the line.

The Essentia Tank Cart holds up to 1024 points of one aspect. Pour jars and phials into it by hand, or run it over an Essentia Loader: a block laid under a rail that joins the cart above to your tubes. A loader fills the cart from the tubes; use it with an empty hand and it empties the cart into them instead. A broken cart keeps its essentia on the item.
Golems work tirelessly, but a cart that never stops is no use to them. Something has to hold it still and show them where the cargo is.

A Golem Station sits under a rail and holds the cart above it in place. Golems, hoppers and pipes see the cart's inventory as the station's own, so Fill and Empty seals work on it directly. In unload mode it lets the cart go once it is empty; use it with an empty hand for load mode, where it lets the cart go once it is full. A redstone signal releases the cart at once.
research.arcanelocomotion.railcraft_arca: Rails, carts and boilers are craft, not magic. Still, a goggled eye finds plenty of Machina, Motus and Metallum in a railway, and a thaumaturge who rides the rails will want tools that know both trades.

Railcraft's metals, stones, tanks and machines now show their aspects to a Thaumometer like any other item, and its carts carry aspects of their own. This tab gathers the tools and engines that join the two crafts.
research.arcanelocomotion.rune_signals.s: A Thaumometer reads the aspects of a passing cart at a glance. A rune cut into the track bed could read them as well, and answer in redstone.

A Rune Signal sits under a rail. Use a phial, jar or any item on it to tune it to one aspect (the item's strongest); use it with an empty hand to clear it. While the cart above carries that aspect, in its tank or anywhere in its cargo, the signal gives full redstone power to every side: enough to throw a switch motor and send Ignis one way and iron the other.
research.arcanelocomotion.spectral_rails: Air and order, woven tight enough, will bear a cart's weight for a little while. Long enough to cross a ravine, anyway.

Use the Spectral Rail Rod on a block to lay up to eight rails forward from it, in the direction you face. They hang in the air with nothing under them, drop nothing, and fade a minute later. Each rail costs half a vis each of Aer and Ordo from a wand in your inventory.
research.arcanelocomotion.thaumic_steam_: A steam locomotive is a firebox, a boiler and a great deal of shovelling. Ignis is fire in its purest form, and Aqua is water. Fed straight into the firebox and boiler, they would spare the fireman.

The Thaumic Steam Locomotive runs like a Railcraft steam locomotive but fires its boiler with Ignis essentia: use a jar or phial of Ignis on it to pour it in. Each point of Ignis heats the firebox like a quarter of a lump of coal; when the Ignis runs out it burns its ordinary fuel. Aqua essentia poured in the same way turns into boiler water, a quarter bucket per point. It holds 256 of each, and keeps them when it is broken and picked up.
research.arcanelocomotion.thaumium_crowb: Thaumium holds an edge and takes an enchantment far better than iron. Bent into a crowbar, it ought to make a trackman's best friend.

The Thaumium Crowbar does everything a Railcraft crowbar does: it turns and flips track, links and boosts carts, and pries apart the blocks a crowbar is meant for. It lasts as long as a steel one and takes enchantments as readily as any thaumium tool.
research.arcanelocomotion.void_crowbar.s: Void metal is brittle, yet it remembers its shape and slowly flows back into it. A crowbar that straightens itself between jobs would never need a smith.

The Void Metal Crowbar works and hits harder than its thaumium cousin, and while it is carried it mends one point of wear every second. Like all void metal gear it whispers to its owner: carrying it adds one warp.
